t: The Reprocessor is a 3 by 3 and 7 blocks high machine build from Casing blocks and one each of the other device parts.$(br)Glass can be used in place of Casing blocks in the vertical faces of the machine (but not on the frame).$(br2)Check each Reprocessor part page for restriction on where each part can be placed.
再处理器是一台 3×3、总高 7 格的机器，由机壳方块以及其他各一个设备部件构成。$(br)在机器的竖直侧面上，可以使用玻璃代替机壳方块（但不能放在框架上）。$(br2)关于各个部件可放置位置的限制，请查看对应的再处理器部件页面。
